preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi, _, _ in threads)
preconditions.description: Each thread must connect nodes within the valid range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 1000000006 for _, _, xi, _ in threads)
preconditions.description: The clamminess of each thread must be between 1 and 1,000,000,006.

postconditions.description: The output must be the jelliness of the cobweb modulo 10^9 + 7.
If there are no valid paths, the jelliness must be 1; otherwise, it must be greater than 1.
